name: Failed payment recovery
description: When a charge fails, draft a dunning outreach, gate it behind a human approval, retry the charge through your billing system, and notify the collections channel.

requiredCredentials.name: billing_webhook
requiredCredentials.purpose: Signs the retry-charge call to your billing system

requiredCredentials.name: billing_slack
requiredCredentials.purpose: Posts the recovery outcome to your collections channel

eventId.description: Stable delivery id from the billing system

invoiceId.description: Invoice id the failed charge applies to

amountUsd.description: Amount of the failed charge in USD

reason.description: Decline reason reported by the payment processor

config.prompt: Write a short, friendly dunning message under 120 words asking the customer to update their payment method. Return JSON with exactly one string field named message. Customer: {{context.trigger.output.event.payload.customer}}, invoice: {{context.trigger.output.event.payload.invoiceId}}, amount: ${{context.trigger.output.event.payload.amountUsd}}, decline reason: {{context.trigger.output.event.payload.reason}}.

input.text: :credit_card: Recovery attempted for {{context.trigger.output.event.payload.customer}} (invoice {{context.trigger.output.event.payload.invoiceId}}, ${{context.trigger.output.event.payload.amountUsd}}). Outreach drafted and charge retried.

failureFixtures.label: Billing credential unavailable
failureFixtures.description: The retry node crosses the real worker and terminal-failure boundary. The retry policy classifies a controlled missing-secret probe as non-retryable before any billing request can start.
